name: g-surge
description: Endless antigrav runner built on three.js r128.

scripts.server:dev: npm run server:build && wrangler -c server/wrangler.jsonc dev
scripts.server:deploy: npm run server:build && wrangler -c server/wrangler.jsonc deploy
scripts.server:deploy:staging: npm run server:build && wrangler -c server/wrangler.jsonc deploy --env staging
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/sim && tsc -p src/client && tsc -p server && tsc -p tests
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.test:e2e:update: docker compose --profile tools run --rm e2e npx playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.readme:shot: docker compose --profile tools run --rm -e README_SHOT=1 e2e npx playwright test tests/e2e/readme-shot.spec.ts --project=desktop
